subject: Arkadia renewal — request executive authorization for retention package
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Arkadia renewal — request executive authorization for retention package

Team — quick summary and ask below. I need exec authorization to offer a one-time concession package to keep Arkadia (DEAL-2981) from churn.

Context:
- ARR: ~$920k (annual pre-tax). Renewal due 12/31.
- Customer has indicated they will pause renewal unless we address perceived pricing and uptime risk; procurement escalation happening.
- They requested: 25% list discount + 12-month term reset + $120k onboarding credit + permanent SLA uplift.

Our recommended save package (sales ops + AM proposed):
- 15% one-time renewal discount (applied to first-year invoice)
- $40,000 onboarding/implementation credit (one-time)
- 9-month SLA uplift to 99.9% availability credit policy (temporary addendum)
- Mandatory QBR cadence + usage expansion target (6 months) and clawback if churn within 9 months

Why this is reasonable:
- Protects revenue while addressing their immediate cost concerns.
- Limits long-term P&L impact via term-limited SLA add-on and clawback.

Ask: Exec approval to offer the above package (or sign off on a counter if leadership wants deeper concessions). If approved, legal should prepare a 1-page amendment and finance should confirm margin impact and amortization schedule.

Attachments: [Attachment: arkadia_proposed_concession_summary.pdf (2 pages)]

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Strategic Renewals
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T12:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Arkadia renewal — request executive authorization for retention package

Mina — thanks for the clear write-up. I agree the proposed package is directionally right. A few quick asks before I send to Vivek for sign-off:

1) Finance (Aditya) — please provide a P&L impact and recommended max discount. If we can cap at 12% discount + $35k credit, that keeps margin within our guardrails.
2) Legal (Laura) — draft a 1-page addendum with a 9-month SLA uplift and standard clawback language (pro-rata credit recovery if they churn within 9 months).
3) Karthik — can you confirm customer tone/likelihood of expansion? I want to ensure we get a usage/expansion commit in writing before we finalize.

If finance/legal are comfortable, I'll loop Vivek for final approval above the finance cap.

—Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Arkadia renewal — request executive authorization for retention package

Marissa/Mina — ran a quick model and attached a short workbook. Key points:
- Baseline margin on Arkadia is ~42% pre-support credits.
- A 15% discount + $40k credit reduces first-year gross margin to ~28% (one-time hit).
- If we amortize the $40k credit over 12 months for revenue recognition, the monthly hit is manageable, but still material to Q4.

Recommendation: cap discount at 12% and credit at $35k. If leadership wants >12%, recommend we require a 12-month non-cancelable commitment or a 6-month revenue guarantee. Also recommend adding a clawback tied to churn/usage.

Attachment: [Attachment: finance-model-arkadia.xlsx]

-Aditya
Finance Manager, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Arkadia renewal — request executive authorization for retention package

Team — I reviewed Mina's ask and Aditya's model. I will approve a one-time package up to the following, conditional on legal and sales commitments:

- Discount: 15% one-time (applied to renewal invoice)
- Onboarding/implementation credit: $40,000 (one-time)
- SLA uplift: 9 months of 99.9% credit policy (explicitly time-limited)

Conditions:
1) Legal to prepare amendment with clawback that recovers the credit on voluntary churn within 9 months.
2) Sales (Mina/Karthik) must secure a signed expansion commitment (letter/email) for a minimum of 6 additional named seats or feature add-on within 6 months, or a 12-month minimum commitment.
3) Finance to confirm amortization and that this will not push Q4 guidance below internal threshold (Aditya, confirm).

If those conditions can be met, proceed. Please update HubSpot (Deal 2981) and send a short concession memo to CS/Onboarding.

-Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
